items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And I just did some duo things with Sue Raney, also for this same label.

ctx.x: Of the recordings you’ve done, are there any that stick out in your mind as being your best work?

Yeah it always seems like as you do more recent stuff that always seems better because you keep evolving and growing. We just recently did a record for Fresh Sound which is from Barcelona I think, with Bud Shank. It’s Mike Wofford playing piano and Joe LaBarbara, myself and Bud. And we did all music associated with Bill Evans. And it was really a fun project. I was happy with that. It was one of those dates we went in the studio and it just felt like we were playing live someplace, which is kind of hard to get…
Do your kids listen to your music?
